prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.2*Z0 + 0.3*Z1 - 0.1*Z2 + 0.4*Z3 - 0.3*Z4 + 0.3*Z0*Z1 + 0.4*Z1*Z2 - 0.2*Z2*Z3 + 0.5*Z3*Z4 (single-qubit 'field' terms on every qubit plus a chain of pairwise coupling terms). gamma = 0.4. Any correct implementation is accepted (every term is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the correct combined phase per computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition). No measurement.
